bullets.note:
from Johns Hopkins Magazine -- Dr. Roland Griffiths' psilocybin experiments
have produced striking evidence for therapeutic uses of hallucinogens,
[including this
study](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavhxvldx/opfkhq/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY3Jvd2RyaXNlLmNvbS90aW1mZXJyaXNz)
that many of you helped fund (more updates on that coming soon). This article
digs into some of the background, science, and details.**

bullets.title: Gipsy project // Bireli Lagrene
bullets.note:
I love writing to this. Why? No idea. But, man, it’s good.**Video you might
have missed —**  
I’m often asked about my morning routine, which I detailed at length in [a
previous
podcast.](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavhxvldx/pnceh9/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE3LzA3LzE5L21vcm5pbmctcm91dGluZXMtYW5kLXN0cmF0ZWdpZXMv)
For me, [a reliable nighttime
routine](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavhxvldx/xksph6/aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9lTFlxaGV6QUNwYw==)
is just as important. [This short
video](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavhxvldx/60aeh8/aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9lTFlxaGV6QUNwYw==)
explains the exact protocol I use to wind down in the last 60 minutes of my
day.**

bullets.title: “Inspiration is for amateurs — the rest of us just show up and get to work. And the belief that things will grow out of the activity itself and that you will, through work, bump into other possibilities and kick open other doors that you would never have dreamt of if you were just sitting around looking for a great ‘art idea’.” -Chuck Close, American artist who achieved fame as a photorealist through massive-scale portraits
